findings.required: 按对象和实际construct/mutate/publish/query等操作申报，明确任务或宿主私有实例及生命周期；保持candidate，不新增core依赖或WC构造权限

tests.algorithm: independent Python arbitrary-precision; prime parsed fixed 128-bit hexadecimal, modulo 2^128

semanticReview.Event: 已读原Event.hpp/EventTest.cpp、core参考总线及execution生产总线；直接列表同步遍历与专用线程/帧快照/锁外回调/drain/RAII差异真实；原EventTest两项与适用性一项实跑通过
semanticReview.core: Identity/Provenance/SourcedValue/Evaluation/DiagData/Events只登记pending；稳定码归diagnostics、结果信封归evidence，core无依赖变化。泛型noexcept、聚合可变性、最终符号及消费者兼容性仍未验证
semanticReview.inputNarrowing: 可按真实源码族去掉无关IdentityTest/EventsTest/probe输入；仍保留或说明Provenance→Identity(ObjectId)/Digest(ContentVersion)，DiagData→Identity/Provenance/Units，Events→Identity/Evaluation(TaskState)的真实跨族载荷依赖。仅实际FNV/Event适用性行关联新probe，不提升pending
semanticReview.probe: 只调既有公开API并冻结固定向量，原EventTest源直接编译；未写哈希、事件总线或其他核心实现
